known_results: Flexible nonlinear measured weather explained only 11.4% of the original concentration residual.
Species-specific 72-h ERA5 rainfall amount explained only 6.5% of the same-sample linear residual.
Bounded residual route-night dependence remained positive, strongest among dry-route-silent taxa, and persisted under same-observer restriction.
provenance.new_unread_question: Whether measured route-night acoustic detection conditions further reproduce concentration or bounded residual dependence has not been evaluated under the strongest q comparator.

question: Can measured route-night acoustic detection conditions, added to the strongest measured-weather and site-history comparator, explain the residual within-taxon multi-site allocation and bounded route-night dependence?

detection_covariates.source: Recorded NAAMP survey-quality fields, calculated exactly as scripts/naamp/run_naamp_detection_quality_robustness.py.
primary: hearing_impairment_fraction: fraction of >=8 sampled stops with Noise=1 or MassNoiseIndex>=2
timeout_fraction: fraction of >=8 sampled stops with TimeOut=1
mean_wind: mean of valid run StartWind and EndWind Beaufort codes 0-5
not_primary: mean_mass_noise_index because it is programme-specific and lower-coverage
detection_covariates.focal_complete_case_rule: Both wet and dry route-runs must have finite values for all three primary detection covariates, in addition to ERA5 and strictly-prior-history eligibility.

same_sample_comparison.baseline: Re-run the frozen 72-h rainfall common-environment q generator on the exact detection-complete focal subset.
same_sample_comparison.augmented: Add the three detection-quality covariates to the species-specific cross-fitted common-environment model on the exact same focal subset.
same_sample_comparison.primary_quantity: Change in conditional concentration residual and change in bounded dry-route-silent residual dependence.

crossfit_species_model.split: Existing deterministic SHA256 route fold; focal route predicted only by opposite fold.
crossfit_species_model.response: Calling-positive stop count out of ten for each species x route-run.
crossfit_species_model.training_population: Runs with valid 72-h ERA5 rainfall and finite hearing_impairment_fraction, timeout_fraction and mean_wind.
crossfit_species_model.minimum_information: At least 20 positive stop cells and at least 5 positive routes in the training fold; otherwise environmental shift is zero.
fixed_terms: cubic B-spline log(1 + 72-h ERA5 precipitation mm), 4 df
cubic B-spline mean route-run air temperature, 4 df
log(1 + DaysSinceRain) x log(1 + 72-h rainfall mm)
log(1 + 72-h rainfall mm) x mean temperature

q_construction.site_structure: Strictly-prior species x physical-SiteID probability plus a=0.75 dry-state persistence.
q_construction.shift: Cross-fitted wet minus dry predicted species logit shift shared across the ten stops.
q_construction.magnitude: One pair-level common logit shift matching expected total wet calling incidence to observed.

concentration.conditioning: Existing conditional regression on simulated route-new-species and total extra-stop rainfall coefficients.

bounded_dependence.coefficient: rho_b = 2 * sum_c sum_{j<k} e_cj e_ck / [9 * sum_c sum_j e_cj^2]
strata: all fixed-support species x route-night clusters
dry-route-silent taxa defined from drier survey only

decisions.concentration_sufficient: Detection-augmented observed residual lies within its 95% null residual interval.
decisions.bounded_dependence_removed: Detection-augmented bounded coefficient does not exceed its independent-Bernoulli null upper 95% quantile.
decisions.residual_after_detection: Either concentration remains above its null upper 95% bound or bounded dry-route-silent dependence remains positive by the fixed upper-tail rule.

boundaries: This is post-hoc exploratory falsification, not independent confirmation.
Recorded detection covariates are incomplete proxies for detectability and do not exclude all acoustic observation error.
Do not infer a biological mechanism merely because measured detection covariates fail.
Do not change the complete-case rule, covariates, spline df, interactions, q construction, seeds, tail, or endpoints after readback.
